summary: Columbus County steel tower recorded at 93 ft and erected in 1929 five miles north of Wananish; no later history or current status found.

facts.agency: North Carolina Division of Forest Resources

events.note: Erected five miles north of Wananish, per the Forest Lookouts page, which cites a 1928-30 state biennial report.

evidence.quote: 1929: A 93-foot steel tower was erected 5 miles north of Wananish.

evidence.quote: (Department of Conservation and Development - 3rd Biennial Report 1928-30)

notes_for_editor: Thin: one Forest Lookouts page gives the 1929 erection, height and agency; a tower list gives coordinates; the Forest History Society inventory is statewide context only. No staffing, fire, fate or current-site information was found. Brief height 28.3 m matches 93 ft (28.35 m). Conflict to check by hand: a DigitalNC photo record titled Waccamaw Tower 100 ft LS-40 Aermotor (Columbus County) came up in search and suggests a 100-foot lattice tower, which disagrees with the 93-foot steel tower on the Forest Lookouts page. The DigitalNC page returned a bot challenge when fetched, so it is neither cited nor used; the story does not mention it. Status and access remain unknown.
